instructions: Android Use controls one real Android device. android.read looks without changing anything; android.act changes the device. Start with android.read screen (or page for the Chrome tab) when the state is unknown. Act on a label you saw, in straight double quotes: tap "Wi-Fi", type "hello" in "Message". Each successful action reports what is on screen now, so a separate read is rarely needed. Join a few steps with then. stale means nothing ran: retry. partial or unknown means read the screen before changing anything again; never repeat blindly. Ask the user before purchases, sending messages, account or security changes, deleting data, or using the camera, microphone, location, or screen recording.

tools.description:
Look at the connected Android device without changing it. Send one command:
status | screen | screen full | screen changes | screen matching "TEXT" | find "TEXT"
page | page text | page text matching "TEXT" | browser tabs (Chrome)
notifications | location | capabilities | image hash "NAME" | image difference "A" and "B"
screen lists visible controls as `Label — state kind`; a duplicated label shows the (number N) to use. If a screen has little readable text, its image is attached. Read only when you do not already know the state: android.act reports the screen after each change.
tools.name: android.read
tools.title: Read the Android device

tools.description:
Change the connected Android device with one plain command. Quote the exact visible label in straight double quotes; add number N after a duplicated label. Join up to 16 changes with then.
Android: tap "LABEL" | toggle "LABEL" | hold "LABEL" | type "TEXT" in "FIELD" | scroll up|down|left|right [in "AREA"] | press back|home|recents|notifications|enter | open app "NAME" | open setting "wifi|bluetooth|display|sound|notifications|apps|battery|accessibility|date and time|developer options" | open link "https://…"
Checks: wait for "LABEL" up to N seconds | wait for text "TEXT" up to N seconds | wait for screen change up to N seconds | verify "LABEL" exists | verify "LABEL" is gone | verify text "TEXT" exists (N ≤ 30)
Chrome: page open "URL" | page click "LABEL" | page type "TEXT" in "FIELD" | page press "Enter|Tab|Escape|Backspace|ArrowUp|ArrowDown" | page scroll PIXELS | page wait for text "TEXT" up to N seconds | page back | page reload | page screenshot | new tab "URL" | select tab "TITLE" | close tab "TITLE"
Media and notifications (ask the user first): capture screen | take rear|front camera photo | record microphone|screen for N seconds | open notification "TITLE" | dismiss notification "TITLE" | run notification action "TITLE"
Fallback after an attached screen image only: tap point X Y | swipe from X1 Y1 to X2 Y2 over MS milliseconds (image pixel coordinates).
Results say what ran and what is on screen now. stale = nothing ran, retry; partial or unknown = read before changing anything again.
tools.name: android.act
tools.title: Act on the Android device
